claim: Restaurant Aqua is permanently closing on March 21, 2026, with a single 8-course farewell menu through final service
quote: Restaurant Aqua will be closing. Until the final service on March 20, 2026, a single 8-course menu will be served.

claim: Until closure, Aqua operates Wednesday to Saturday from 6 pm; reservations via phone +49 5361 606056 or OpenTable
quote: from Wednesday to Saturday from 6:00 pm onwards

claim: Aqua held three Michelin stars uninterrupted since 2009 under chef Sven Elverfeld, who opened the restaurant in 2000
quote: Under Sven Elverfeld's leadership, Aqua earned its first Michelin star in 2002, a second in 2006, and achieved the coveted three-star status in 2009

claim: Elverfeld is closing Aqua to support his wife Saskia's project running the Parkhotel Wolfsburg, with no concrete successor restaurant announced
quote: support his wife's hospitality project in Wolfsburg and to explore future creative work beyond the confines of a three-star kitchen

claim: Marriott press release confirms Elverfeld's closure announcement framed as supporting his wife Saskia's takeover of Parkhotel Wolfsburg
quote: Ein Lebenswerk endet – damit ein Lebenstraum entstehen kann

claim: Terra is the surviving Ritz-Carlton Wolfsburg restaurant with seasonal regional cuisine, floor-to-ceiling windows over the VW works and harbour basin
quote: Terra is a restaurant in the Ritz-Carlton hotel that boasts a bright and elegantly modern interior

claim: Terra is rated 4.7 stars by OpenTable diners and is bookable via OpenTable; signature dishes include braised veal cheek with mustard jus and vegetarian options
quote: Terra is rated 4.7 stars by 306 OpenTable diners

claim: Autostadt operates nine restaurants including Mondo Italiano (Italian by the canal), Lagune (breakfast/lunch/afternoon), Beef Club steakhouse, Amano pizza, and Das Brot. bakery
quote: Handgemachte Pizza aus dem Steinofen, Salate, Pasta und leckere Desserts

claim: Only Autostadt restaurants inside the park (Tachometer, Erste Sahne) require a day ticket or annual pass; others such as Lagune and Mondo Italiano can be accessed without a park ticket
quote: Only to access the restaurants inside the park such as Tachometer and 'Erste Sahne' you need a valid day-ticket or annual pass.

claim: Altes Brauhaus zu Fallersleben brews Fallersleber Schlossbräu on-site since 1986 with around 20 hand-brewed beers using organic malt since 2019, serving Schnitzel, Sauerfleisch, Grünkohl and Bregenwurst
quote: Fallersleber Schlossbräu brewed here since 1986. There are around 20 different naturally cloudy, hand-brewed beers available, made exclusively with organic malt since 2019

claim: Restaurant Schlossremise at Wolfsburg Castle occupies a former horse stable, serving German-Mediterranean cuisine (Schnitzel, ravioli, beef filet) at €20–50 per person with 100 indoor + 80 terrace seats
quote: Formerly used as a horse stable, the restaurant Schlossremise today offers gastronomy with a very special flair at Wolfsburg Castle

claim: Allerlei Restaurant & Bar sits in the Allerpark by Volkswagen Arena with Allersee views, regional modern cuisine under head chef Patrick Brümmerhof; bookable via OpenTable
quote: head chef Patrick Brümmerhof focusing on regional products, strong flavors, and modern cooking methods

claim: aalto am see on the Allersee promenade offers steaks and seafood front-cooking at roughly €40–50 per dish; no walk-ins — reservations via phone/WhatsApp +49 171 5720807 only
quote: The fastest and safest way to make a reservation is to send a WhatsApp message or call. The restaurant does not allow walk-ins

claim: Tripadvisor's top-rated Wolfsburg dinner picks include Claras Restaurant (Italian, 4.9), Te Nona (steakhouse/German, 4.6), Trattoria Tarallo (Italian, 4.5), AN NAM (Vietnamese, 4.2) and Creasian (Chinese/Japanese, 4.2)
Independent Michelin-tracker Étoile lists only one starred restaurant in Wolfsburg (Aqua, three stars) with no Bib Gourmand or one-star entries identified in the city
quote: There is 1 three-star establishment in the city, with no two-star or one-star restaurants listed.
